vulnerabilities.reason: Low-severity hash flooding in HashBiMap/LinkedHashMultimap construction, published only in guava's repository on 2026-10-31 for 13.0 through 33.7.2 with no fixed release. Here guava runs only inside build tools (Checkstyle, annotation processors), not in the library. Revisit when a fix or a reviewed record exists.

releaseAge.reason: Owner's decision (2026-11-02) to take the fix before the 7-day wait: 1.5.7-25 fixes three memory-safety advisories (two high) published 2026-10-28 only in zstd-jni's repository, so none is reviewed yet and none can justify the young version on its own.
